items.scope: TRANSLATOR SHELF — all John Dryden translations, each title its own uid; own grouping; shelf + fetch + map section
items.notes: Shelf pipeline/dryden_shelf.json: 10 sources fetched (8 PG, 2 IA), 7.5 MB; 21 titles cut by heading marker with new pipeline/split_shelf_titles.py (all 21 cut, 0 failed). Defects: (1) titles NOT converted to unit-id JSON - converters need a fetch_sources.py manifest entry, which relay rules forbid; (2) dryden-history-of-the-league is long-s OCR (78% of tokens in a clean-text vocabulary vs 94% for the Scott volumes); (3) dryden-metamorphoses is the Garth composite (many hands), raw OCR (95% vocab hit, good); (4) no uids minted - all 21 await Adam. Scott vol 1 (Life) not on PG; not a translation, out of scope. 'started' corrected from an estimated 15:20 to 15:12.

items.scope: TRANSLATOR SHELF — Constance Garnett's Russians (Dostoevsky, Tolstoy, Chekhov, Turgenev, Gogol), each title its own uid, record edition/year; own grouping; shelf + fetch + map section
items.notes: Shelf pipeline/garnett_shelf.json: 60 sources (40 PG, 20 IA), 40.3 MB, 0 failed; 52 titles cut (multi-volume titles joined), 0 failed. Every PG file's Translator line reads Constance Garnett. IA OCR quality 0.92-0.97 (share of tokens in a clean Garnett vocabulary; PG Anna Karenina 0.962). Defects: not converted to unit-id JSON (needs fetch_sources.py entry: off limits); no uids minted (52 titles await Adam); War and Peace, House of the Dead, Honest Thief, plays are later printings (scan_edition recorded); Notes from Underground still inside garnett-white-nights; Gogol vols 3-6, Poor Folk, Uncle's Dream not found with a verified title page (pending).

items.scope: Overflow (found while finishing shelf-garnett): Gogol vols 3-6 scans, Notes from Underground as its own cut title, re-check Poor Folk / Uncle's Dream attribution
items.notes: Added Gogol: The Overcoat and Other Stories (1923) and Evenings on a Farm near Dikanka (1926), both Knopf scans naming Garnett; Notes from Underground cut from White Nights as its own title (overlap flagged for minting). Still pending: Government Inspector (1926), Mirgorod (1928) - no verified scan. Poor Folk / Uncle's Dream: no Garnett version found; IA 1915 copies are Hogarth (Everyman). Shelf now 62 sources, 55 titles.
